# Roadmap — independent Rust + Bevy engine

<!-- Generated by scripts/dashboard.py from docs/dashboard/data.json. -->

Updated: 2026-11-05. **Foundations; game not playable in this engine.**

Each task is a verifiable deliverable, not an estimate of game coverage.
Done applies only to the stated criteria. No release schedule is promised.

Next useful evidence: Development goal paused by the owner; GPU integration remains pending explicit resume.

## M0 — Public foundations

Make work reproducible and traceable.

Dependencies: none.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | Rust workspace and pinned dependencies | Done | Three-crate workspace, Bevy 0.20.1 and Cargo.lock. |
| F02 | Provenance protocol | Done | Document observation, contract and implementation separation, and contribution rules. |
| F03 | Tests without game data | Done | Verify reader and simulation with synthetic fixtures. |
| F04 | Public MIT repository | Done | Check the index and publish original source only. |
| F05 | Free Pages journal | Done | Working public URL, short dated entries, roadmap link and actual journal capture. |
| F06 | Continuous validation | Done | Rust formatting/tests, Bevy compilation and publication checks pass on GitHub. |
| E01 | Local third-party native backend evaluation | Done | Pinned build, first fight observed and runtime snapshot reloaded; written report with limits. Not an independent-engine feature. |
| I01 | Versioned reference inventory | Done | Separate retail/prototype profiles, synthetic inventory tests and private corrected CUE; original images untouched. Prototype runtime validation remains separate. |
| I02 | Adaptive initialization workflow | Done | Executable development commands, bounded G1 criteria, decision log and contract template. |
| I03 | First bounded AFS catalog slice | Done | Original header/table contract, checked ISO file views, synthetic malformed cases and owned-retail metadata-only smoke. No FST or payload decoding claimed. |
| I04 | Persistent progress and original comparison publication | Done | Resume/checkpoint protocol, reviewed content-addressed original PNG pairs, synthetic preparation/validation tests and side-by-side HTML support. A real matched game comparison is a separate open fidelity gate. |

## M1 — From disc to data

Read the formats without distributing their contents.

Dependencies: M0.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D01 | Read-only ISO reader | Done | ISO 9660 root, SYSTEM.CNF, USA identification and bounds checks. |
| D02 | Disc fingerprint and diagnostics | Planned | Local fingerprints and precise errors for truncated discs or different editions. |
| D03 | Independent FST / AFS contract | Done | Original bounded FST namespace and AFS ordinal contract, synthetic malformed cases, complete retail/prototype ordinal coverage; opaque metadata preserved. |
| D04 | Archive access | Done | Bounded read-only ISO and AFS member windows; rejects invalid ordinals and reads/seeks outside a member. No whole-archive extraction. |
| D05 | Local conversion pipeline | Planned | Private cache versioned by format and invalidated reliably. |
| D06 | Tagged room-container and SCR node metadata | Done | Bounded DAT/SCP tables across 94 retail candidates and 93 nonempty SCP catalogs; SCR signed references and finite raw transforms checked on three samples. Mesh decoding remains separate. |
| D07 | Static MDB and TM3/TIM3 profile | Done | Bounded static flag-zero MDB and observed linear/GS-transfer indexed TIM3 profile; 433 meshes and 158 bank images on three retail candidates. Unsupported variants refused; runtime parity remains open. |

## M2 — Scenes and rendering

Display a first scene from personal game data.

Dependencies: M1.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R01 | Bevy viewer foundation | Done | Original primitive viewer compiled and rendered on Windows/Vulkan with bounded smoke exit; not a game scene. |
| R02 | Window and GPU diagnostics | Done | Verify local execution, readable GPU errors and original sandbox capture. |
| R03 | Textures and materials | In progress | Verified texture/material behavior, including correct alpha/depth interaction. Raw color modulation and a CPU alpha-stage write-permission model exist; real full-resource depth controls expose host-pipeline errors. GPU write/discard paths, per-draw state, blending/filter/light/fog and complete material fidelity remain pending. |
| R04 | Geometry and scenes | In progress | Load hierarchy, meshes, materials and positions from ISO. Two retail viewpoints support static unit-scale/zero-rotation placement with whole-resource holdouts. General transforms, hierarchy, active-resource selection, other rooms and runtime camera behavior remain pending. |
| R05 | Skeletons and animation | Planned | Poses/transitions match observable contracts; test interpolation. |
| R06 | Camera and visibility | Planned | Specify and validate camera behavior, camera collisions, framing and occlusion. |
| R07 | Image quality | Planned | Resolution, aspect ratio, UI scaling and settings preserve simulation behavior. |
| R08 | Isolated real static-asset inspection | Done | An ISO-backed well-like prop displays five mesh buffers with five referenced textures in Bevy; private screenshot and bounded native exit. Does not establish room placement or game lighting. |

## M3 — Movement and simulation

Specify the feel before rebuilding combat.

Dependencies: M2.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | Coordinates and fixed step | Done | Y is height, generic normalized movement; explicitly document provisional 60 Hz. |
| S02 | Input and remapping | Planned | Keyboard/controller, deadzones, buffered edges and configurable bindings. |
| S03 | Player locomotion | Planned | Measure speeds, turning and transitions through independent observation. |
| S04 | Collisions and ground | Planned | Specify and test contacts, slopes, steps and obstacles. |
| S05 | Dodging and interaction | Planned | Derive invulnerability, timing and interactions from observable contracts. |
| S06 | Input replay | Planned | Reproducible synthetic sequences, state hashes and divergence detection. |

## M4 — Combat and opponents

Reach a verifiable combat loop.

Dependencies: M3.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 | Combat state machine | Planned | Document states, transitions, priorities and action windows. |
| C02 | Moves and combos | Planned | Interpret commands, timing, cancels and move data. |
| C03 | Hits and reactions | Planned | Test volumes, reach, damage, hitstop, guard and throws. |
| C04 | Special abilities | Planned | Gauges, activation and action selection match contracts. |

Connect systems to progress through the game.

## M6 — Validation and distribution

Make the engine usable and preserve evidence.

Dependencies: M5.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q01 | Behavioral comparison | Planned | PCSX2/console protocol, tolerances and written results without proprietary data. |
| Q02 | Full playthroughs | Planned | Document multiple complete runs, save/resume and regressions. |
| Q03 | Performance and accessibility | Planned | CPU/GPU measurements, stability, accessible controls and readable options. |
| Q04 | Windows and Linux | Planned | Installation and smoke tests on target machines; no untested platform promises. |
| Q05 | Engine distribution | Planned | Original-code binaries only, notices and ISO check at startup. |
| Q06 | Documentation and contributions | Planned | User guide, component provenance and reproducible reporting. |

## Outside the public repository

Discs, BIOS files, extracted data, translated game code, dumps and unselected captures stay local.
Selected rendered reference/Bevy screenshots may be published under the [comparison protocol](docs/progress-tracking.md).
See [the independent method](docs/clean-room.md) and [notices](NOTICE.md).
